dialogue.realtalk: Of course we can talk. You look like you're carrying something too — we'll trade. What's on your mind?
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Truly good, for once. The bread came out right and the sunrise nearly made me cry. But how are YOU, really?
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: Heavy, honestly. And you asking just now — sorry, give me a moment. That meant something, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: A gentle one. Cold well water, and the baker smiled at me. I keep those. You look tired, though — are you sleeping?
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: Hard. I heard the neighbors arguing and carried it all day like it was mine. I do that. Talking helps, so thank you.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: I do. You can pour a whole mood into your hands and the work just... holds it for you. Does yours do that?
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: Between us... it wears on me. Not the labor — the way nobody asks how it's going. You just did, though. I noticed.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: No one's asked so gently before. It's an ordinary story — but there's a winter in it my eyes still sting over. Sit close.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: A house where nobody leaves the table angry. That's it, that's the whole dream. Small, isn't it? It doesn't feel small.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: That someone I love will be hurting right in front of me and I'll miss it. I check faces the way the guard checks the wall.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: You listen with your whole face, %1$s. Do you know how rare that is? Around you I don't have to be the strong one.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: You're kind to ask — I felt that. But that story still bruises, and I'd want to trust the hands I put it in. Give us time?
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: Gently, %1$s... not yet. That answer lives somewhere very soft. Keep being how you are, and one day it walks out on its own.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: Nothing spoken, anyway. But the mason's been quieter than usual and I don't like it. I'll bring him bread. That's the news.
dialogue.chat: I'm glad you came to talk. Truly. Sit — and don't rush whatever it is.
